title_candidates: They Made Her Eat Below Them, Until a Child Sat Beside Her
The Maid They Called a Thief Was the Only One Who Could Read the Truth
Nobody Wanted the Broken Glasswing Smith — Until the City's Future Depended on Her Hands
logline: In a floating city of glasswing workshops, Sefa, a debt-bound glasswing smith whose late mother taught her to read wing fractures is publicly humiliated and framed as a thief, but the guild heir's six-year-old daughter physically chooses her side; using her craft, a proof chain, and one inherited object, she exposes the real betrayal and turns the place of shame into chosen belonging.
audience_promise: An emotionally legible animated social melodrama: public humiliation, innocent child alliance, craft-based proof, family repair, class reversal, and a circular ending in which the place of shame becomes chosen community.

emotional_engine.wound: Sefa is poor, displaced, and publicly treated as disposable while carrying grief for her parent's stolen craft legacy.
emotional_engine.want: survive, protect family/work obligations, and clear her name
emotional_engine.need: trust that her competence and dignity deserve space without begging for permission
emotional_engine.injustice: the guildmaster's ambitious fiancée enforces status rules, plants blame, and turns public opinion against her
emotional_engine.protective_counterforce: the guild heir's six-year-old daughter physically crosses the status boundary; an elderly furnace keeper gives shelter and work before any romantic rescue
emotional_engine.belonging_payoff: the place of forced humiliation becomes the workshop floor mat where the whole guild eventually eats by choice, and her craft receives paid public recognition
emotional_engine.secret_or_power_asymmetry: wealth, institutional authority, and social opinion stand against a worker whose proof depends on specialized craft knowledge
emotional_engine.cost_of_failure: she loses work, family care, public reputation, and the chance to restore her parent's stolen legacy

protagonist.identity: Sefa, a debt-bound glasswing smith whose late mother taught her to read wing fractures
protagonist.vulnerability: class displacement, debt, public shame, and lack of institutional power
protagonist.capability: glasswing smith expertise, proof literacy, persistence, and dignity-preserving work ethic
protagonist.agency_first_action: she protects the child or another vulnerable person before protecting herself, then chooses work over humiliating charity
protagonist.transformation: from surviving humiliation to authoring the public proof and choosing belonging without surrendering agency

opening_event.first_10_seconds: she is forced to eat scraps beneath the suspended banquet platform while guild guests dine above her
opening_event.first_60_seconds: the guild heir's six-year-old daughter crosses the boundary and sits or eats beside her while adults laugh or film the humiliation.
opening_event.first_5_minutes: an authority figure witnesses the child's choice; an elderly furnace keeper gives shelter and work before any romantic rescue gives concrete help; the inherited cracked blue measuring cup and her craft identity are introduced before the romance/status reversal.
opening_event.dramatic_question: can a publicly shamed craftswoman prove truth without surrendering dignity or becoming dependent on rescue?

theme_lane.family_or_heir_hook: lonely child chooses the morally safe adult before powerful adults understand why
theme_lane.romance_hook: the widowed guild heir learns to trust his daughter's instinct and his own presence at the family table
theme_lane.modern_power_hook: institutional wealth, social spectacle, public accusation, and proof

nearest_failures: abstract kindness without a repeatable object
mitigations: show humiliation spatially in the first minute
make kindness cost something before high-status intervention
seed the proof object and craft competence before the accusation
reassemble the original public audience for reversal
pay off agency through work and changed ritual, not wealth alone
counterexamples_checked: low views do not prove weak story
immediate spectacle alone does not guarantee retention
hidden wealth reveal is weak if treated as reward rather than trust rupture

packaging.thumbnail_single_read: Sefa below the status platform/table while the guild heir's six-year-old daughter crosses to her side and the guildmaster's ambitious fiancée points down
packaging.curiosity_gap: why is the child choosing the person every powerful adult rejects?
packaging.visual_before_after: forced floor/service space becomes chosen communal floor/workbench; dismissed object becomes proof instrument
packaging.title_thumbnail_mismatch_risk: generic billionaire romance packaging would hide the stronger craft-proof and child-truth mechanism

evidence_boundaries: Inspired by mechanism-level evidence in social-test and legal-proof research; characters, world, object, proof chain, and dialogue are original.
No CTR, retention, or traffic causality is claimed from public video metadata.

meaning_carrier.opening_meaning: the cup is the only surviving tool from her mother's bench and is treated as junk
meaning_carrier.closing_reversal: the same cup measures the alloy that proves whose hands made the stolen wings
meaning_carrier.final_sequence_use: the object is used openly in the proof/restoration ritual before the final communal meal in the workshop floor mat where the whole guild eventually eats by choice

relational_contract.power_asymmetry: institutional wealth/status power versus debt-bound worker with no protection
relational_contract.safety_or_kindness_before_power: an elderly furnace keeper gives shelter and work before any romantic rescue offers shelter, food, and paid work before knowing his power or status
relational_contract.costly_protagonist_action: Sefa protects the child or another worker at cost to her job and refuses humiliating payment even when desperate
relational_contract.consent_or_personhood_repair: after the accusation, authority figures must trust her account, return control of the proof, and accept her conditions rather than buying forgiveness
relational_contract.payoff_image: the workshop floor mat where the whole guild eventually eats by choice where everyone eats or works by choice while the restored object remains visible
